Hardy.Name: Hardy
Hardy.Description:
You can survive injuries that would kill lesser people.

Your maximum health is increased by 20

Battle-scarred.Name: Battle-scarred
Battle-scarred.Description:
Not even the most greivous wounds have kept you down for long.

You regenerate 100% more health per second and the amount of time before your health begins regenerating is reduced by 50%

Pile the Bodies High.Name: Pile the Bodies High
Pile the Bodies High.Description:
You're a fearsome combatant and the police grow increasingly hesitant in pursuing you for fear of adding to your extensive body count.

Police search duration is capped at 35 seconds.

If Blood Rush is unlocked, each officer you've killed further reduces the search timer by 0.1 seconds for a maximum reduction of 10 seconds.

Quick Draw McGraw.Name: Quick Draw McGraw
Quick Draw McGraw.Description:
You're the fastest gunslinger in the West(ville).

Aim time for ranged weapons is reduced by 50%.

Sharpshooter.Name: Sharpshooter
Sharpshooter.Description:
You could shoot a fly off a horse's ass at a hundred paces.

Reduces the minimum and maximum spread of ranged weapons by 65%.

Ghost.Name: Ghost
Ghost.Description:
You always stay low-profile and apply a light touch.

Your visibility is reduced by 25% and pickpocketing items is much easier.

Slippery.Name: Slippery
Slippery.Description:
You're an expert at keeping out of reach and breaking the tightest grips.

Reduces police arrest radius by 25% and increases time until arrested by 100%.

Fleet Feet.Name: Fleet Feet
Fleet Feet.Description: Increase movement speed by 15% per level.

Spring-Heeled.Name: Spring-Heeled
Spring-Heeled.Description: Increase max stamina by 30% and jump height by 35%.

Prison Wallet.Name: Prison Wallet
Prison Wallet.Description:
Increase item stack size by 100%.

Does not apply to items with a stack size of 1.

Quantum Stockpile.Name: Quantum Stockpile
Quantum Stockpile.Description:
Increase item stack size by 100% per level, stacking additively with Prison Wallet.

Does not apply to items with a stack size of 1.

Double-Stack Mags.Name: Double-Stack Mags
Double-Stack Mags.Description: Increase ammo capacity of ranged weapons and magazines by 100%.

Circadian Mastery.Name: Circadian Mastery
Circadian Mastery.Description:
You have achieved complete mastery of your sleep cycle.

You are able to sleep while Athletic or Energizing effects are active and can use a bed to rest until the next time period.

Plants only grow at 33% of their normal speed when time is skipped.

Combat Experience.Name: Combat Experience
Combat Experience.Description:
Killing the following NPCs grants XP
- Police Officer: +12 XP
- Cartel Goon: +20 XP
- Cartel Dealer: +30 XP

Pitchin' a Tent.Name: Pitchin' a Tent
Pitchin' a Tent.Description: Increase plant quality for grow tents by 26%.

Advanced Pot Techniques.Name: Advanced Pot Techniques
Advanced Pot Techniques.Description:
Rank 1: Increase plant quality for all pots by 15%.

Rank 2: Increase plant quality for air pots by an additional 20%.

Harder and Stronger.Name: Harder and Stronger
Harder and Stronger.Description: Increase meth and cocaine quality by 1.

Wet-Ass Plants.Name: Wet-Ass Plants
Wet-Ass Plants.Description: Moisture drains 50% slower for all grow containers.

Absorbent Soil.Name: Absorbent Soil
Absorbent Soil.Description: Soil additives last until the soil is depleted.

Green Thumb.Name: Green Thumb
Green Thumb.Description: Increase plant and mushroom growth speed 5%.

Quick Crafter.Name: Quick Crafter
Quick Crafter.Description: Increase the speed of cauldrons, chemistry stations, lab ovens, and mixing stations by 100%.

Bountiful Harvest.Name: Bountiful Harvest
Bountiful Harvest.Description: Increase base yield of plants by 1.

Crankin' One Out.Name: Crankin' One Out
Crankin' One Out.Description: Increase the production capacity of mixing stations and drying racks by 100%.

Witch's Brew.Name: Witch's Brew
Witch's Brew.Description: Increase the output of the cauldron by 100%.

Apprenticeship.Name: Apprenticeship
Apprenticeship.Description:
- Planting seeds/spores grants 2 XP
- Harvesting plants grants an additional 200% XP
- Harvesting mushrooms grants the same XP as plants
- Producing drugs and precursors grants 5 XP
- Packaging drugs grants 1 XP per product
- Mixing grants 1 XP per product
- Creating new mixes grants an additional 25% XP.

Silver Tongued Devil.Name: Silver Tongued Devil
Silver Tongued Devil.Description: Increase chance a potential customer will accept a free sample by 5%

Community Service.Name: Community Service
Community Service.Description:
Through your experience in gathering trash, you've become more adept at picking up and storing trash.

Trash grabbers now pick up trash in a radius roughly equal to a trash bag and can store twice as many items.

Sacar La Basura.Name: Sacar La Basura
Sacar La Basura.Description:
You have the uncanny ability to convince people that your trash is their treasure

Trash is worth $1 more per level and pawned items are worth 25% more per level

Spread the Wealth.Name: Spread the Wealth
Spread the Wealth.Description: Increase citizens' weekly spending limits by 25% per level.

Captive Market.Name: Captive Market
Captive Market.Description: Increase citizens' weekly order limits by 3 per skill level and 1 per player rank.

Hoard the Wealth.Name: Hoard the Wealth
Hoard the Wealth.Description: Increase ATM deposit limit by $2500 per level.

Crystal Ball.Name: Crystal Ball
Crystal Ball.Description:
Your haggling prowess is borderline mystical.

You can see the chance of a customer accepting a counteroffer.

Informant.Name: Informant
Informant.Description:
You know a guy who knows a guy that knows a guy that knows the best ways to avoid law enforcement.

Police are shown on the map.

Spymaster.Name: Spymaster
Spymaster.Description:
Your eyes and ears are everywhere.

Benzies are shown on the map.

Grifter.Name: Grifter
Grifter.Description:
- Gain 200% more XP from successful counteroffers
- Gain 10% of a drug sale's value as bonus XP.

Reliable Business Partner.Name: Reliable Business Partner
Reliable Business Partner.Description: Increase dead drop order limit by 67.5% and item limit by 50%.

Rush Delivery.Name: Rush Delivery
Rush Delivery.Description:
Reduces delivery time

Minimum: 60 minutes -> 30 minutes

Maximum: 6 hours -> 2 hours.

Motivational Leader.Name: Motivational Leader
Motivational Leader.Description: Increase the movement speed of dealers by 100%.

Fast Farmers.Name: Fast Farmers
Fast Farmers.Description: Botanists perform all actions twice as fast.

Fast Handlers.Name: Fast Handlers
Fast Handlers.Description: Packagers perform all actions twice as fast.

Fast Chemists.Name: Fast Chemists
Fast Chemists.Description: Chemists perform all actions twice as fast.

Night Shift.Name: Night Shift
Night Shift.Description: Employees don't stop working at 4 AM.

Overworked and Underpaid.Name: Overworked and Underpaid
Overworked and Underpaid.Description: Increase station assignment limit for botanists and chemists by 2.

Good Samaritan.Name: Good Samaritan
Good Samaritan.Description:
Once per day, destroy all trash on the map and gain 100% of the sell value as online balance.

Default keybind is F1.

Blood Rush.Name: Blood Rush
Blood Rush.Description:
Active ability: Once per day, fully restore health and gain Blood Rush for 60 seconds.

Passive ability: Gain 0.1 max health for every police officer or cartel member killed, up to 30 health.

While Blood Rush is active, the passive health cap is doubled to 60 health and health regen delay is reduced by 80% (90% with Battle-Scarred).

Default keybind is F2.

Siphon Funds.Name: Siphon Funds
Siphon Funds.Description:
Once per day, instantly collect your money from all dealers. 10% + 5% per owned business of collected money is converted to online balance.

Default keybind is F3.

Trickle-down Economics.Name: Trickle-down Economics
Trickle-down Economics.Description:
Once per day, instantly deposit your cash in all owned businesses for laundering while keeping a minimum in reserve.

Laundering operations now pay out in increments of 25% every 6 hours instead of 100% every 24 hours.

Default keybind is F4.

Blood Money.Name: Blood Money
Blood Money.Description:
Once per day, for 30 seconds your health cannot drop below 1 and you gain 100% of all damage received and dealt as cash.

Default keybind is F5.

Infectious Personality.Name: Infectious Personality
Infectious Personality.Description:
Once per day, all NPCs within 15 meters are randomly afflicted with Toxic or Explosive.

Characters afflicted with Toxic die after 8 seconds, characters afflicted with Explosive explode and die after 30 seconds.

Upon death, the effect is spread to nearby characters and half of their health is gained as cash and online balance.

Default keybind is F6.

Adrenaline Surge.Name: Adrenaline Surge
Adrenaline Surge.Description:
Three times per day, your movement speed and jump height are tripled for 15 seconds.

Default keybind is F7.

Anti-Gravity Bong.Name: Anti-Gravity Bong
Anti-Gravity Bong.Description:
Once every 60 seconds, place a special anti-gravity bong that ragdolls and flings away any NPC within a 10 meter radius.

Lasts for 15 seconds. When the skill expires, the bong pulls NPCs towards itself and explodes.

Default keybind is F8.
